text:
monitoring-bot: [ALERT] pagerbridge service spike (5xx) in us-west + eu-west. severity: sev2. automation=incidentbot -> page issued to oncall schedule. incident-id=incident-3225. Affected: multi-tenant customers.
alex: seeing a bunch of near-simultaneous pages, looks like duplicate fanout from incidentbot. suppressor metrics show high retry_count.
jin: i'm jumping on logs for the shadow deploy / webhook path. starting with controller and dispatcher logs.
oncall-bot: incident-3225 auto-acknowledged: assigned to jin. oncall contact: @jin.
carol: customers reporting delayed pages and missed alert windows. support tickets coming in. can we confirm SMS gateway and outbound relay?
sam: quick check: SMS relay health ok, but proxy logs show 502/504 spikes from shadow-webhook target around 3225001225-3225001230.
alex: running quick tail:
```
kubectl -n infra logs deployment/pagerbridge-controller --since=15m | egrep "retry|error|504" | tail -n 50
```
found repeated retry attempts and webhook timeouts.
jin: digging — shadow deploy to handle integration test appears to include a change that altered connection timeout handling. incidentbot treats webhook timeouts as transient and retries immediately -> duplicates. suppressor TTL logic also miscalculated due to new header shape.
alex: can we rollback the shadow deploy in eu-west first, then us-west? I want to avoid global churn.
jin: rolling back eu-west now: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/pagerbridge -n infra --to-revision=12`
oncall-bot: rollback request received for eu-west by jin. ETA ~3m.
carol: i'll update ops-status and draft a short customer message: "Paging delays affecting subset of customers in US-W and EU-W; mitigation in progress."
sam: after rollback started, incoming page volume reduced but queued retries still processing. looks like dispatcher backlog needs manual trimming.
jin: cleared the retry queue on dispatcher API: `POST https://pagerbridge.internal/admin/clear-retry-queue` -> 200 OK. also toggled incidentbot resync: `POST /bot/resync?incident=incident-3225`.
alex: adjusted suppressor dedupe window temporarily: `suppressor.config.set({dedupe_window: "30s"})` to reduce duplicate fanout while we validate fix.
oncall-bot: incident-3225 acknowledged and assigned to jin. Runbook referenced: `/ops/runbooks/paging-duplication`.
carol: customer-impact summary so far: ~27 tenants saw delayed pages (window 3225001220-3225001250). 3 high-priority support tickets opened. No confirmed missed critical on-call escalations yet.
sam: metrics trending back to baseline around 3225001288. error rate dropping after rollback + queue clear.
jin: follow-ups (filed): 1) revert/rework retry/backoff in incidentbot webhook handler, 2) add integration test for shadow-deploy webhook timeouts, 3) metric for duplicated page count and suppressor TTL drift. I'll open PRs and tickets.
alex: thanks team. i'll add a short post-incident note here and hand off to morning oncall. :thumbsup:
carol: creating retro and customer follow-up template now. assigning to product & support for comms.
jin: closing ops actions in channel, leaving incident open for postmortem. will update when tickets are in.
alex: noted. good recovery. keep any remaining logs/snippets in incident ticket.
monitoring-bot: alert resolved for incident-3225 (errors back to baseline).
